data.name: Nizami
data.gender_notes: Nizami is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'nizam' meaning 'order,' or 'system'. This name is often given to those who are knowledgeable and wise. The name Nizami carries the meaning “Memory, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nizami usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Nizami belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Memory, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nizami total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
